scoring_justification: Raw simulation energies and cell areas are not submitted, so full recompute from those is infeasible. Checking structural trends (monotonicity, relative ordering, and model-derived consistency) is the strongest feasible tier.

schema.notes: Six rows: three monolayer densities for each of the two surfaces.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed interfacial energies.

output_contract.notes: The task outputs a single CSV file with the computed interfacial energies. Scoring is based on structural trends (T3) rather than exact numerical match to the paper's values.
